verified: The catalogue Programme tab gives 60 EC in the first year, 18 EC general plus 42 EC Psychology groups in year two, and 6 EC general, 42 EC Psychology groups and a 12 EC thesis in year three. The first-year 0 EC language diagnostic and recurring tutoring are separate obligations. Language and the Human Mind and Computational Perspectives on Cognition and Language are distinct 6 EC courses in place of the old 12 EC Human Cognition aggregate. In year two the 24 EC required group includes the second-year research project, CLC in Research Papers, Introductory Psychology and Brain & Cognition part B and Cognitive Modelling. The year-three Psychology required group is exactly the same Cognitive Modelling course code, ID and block. One award plus both restricted groups at face value is 174 EC. Counting the duplicate twice would produce a spurious 180 EC. The confirmed requirements shown exclude both restricted groups and the unallocated 6 EC. The 30 EC of free choice is 6 EC in year two plus 24 EC in year three. The catalogue rules ordinarily cap level-one courses within free choice at 12 EC, with specific minor and language exceptions.
